scope: retrospective exploratory extension; no Bridge structure, gene sets, TITAN prompts or source data changes; protocol frozen before new fits and direct paired intervals

A.endpoint: DSS primary only; original 512 patients/65 events
A.head_and_selection: exact parent common linear Efron ridge Cox, same four lambdas, same fit-local transforms, same saved inner splits; no stacking or architecture change
A.parent_numeric_identity: integers/Top512/split indices exactly identical; floating normalizers rtol=atol=1e-12 for server CPU rounding, actual maximum discrepancy reported; no altered transforms
A.bootstrap: 5000 paired patient multiplicity draws stratified by fixed fold/event, seed 88211; shared draws across methods and three seeds; fixed-OOF conditional intervals
A.decision: five-pair family 99% Harrell interval lower bound >0, all three seed Harrell increments positive, positive mean Uno60; also require within-fold and raw-risk mean differences positive to call calibration-robust
A.limitations: joint refit adjusts Clinical coefficients; no-significance does not prove conditional mutual information equals zero; CNA restricted to existing signed gene-set means, not an audit of every CNA encoder

B.representations: unchanged eight RNA and eight CNA gene-z mean states, frozen 32 TITAN concept scores
B.nuisance: AGE/SEX/Stage/T/N/M plus COAD/READ and three-level primary-tumor RNA platform (GAII only, HiSeq only, both annotations); train-only one-hot/age imputation
B.residualization: five fixed patient folds; fit minimum-norm OLS nuisance regression on each outer-train for states/concepts, train-residual SD scaling, evaluate outer-test residuals; no hyperparameter selection or survival labels
B.primary_map: unchanged Phase7-P0 15 RNA associations, direction unspecified; CNA full matrix audited separately without asserting the same RNA prior
B.statistics: OOF Pearson residual correlations, per-fold signs and unadjusted correlations; global prior-edge mean squared correlation
B.patient_permutations: 1999 unrestricted residual-row permutations within outer-fold x cancer-type x platform, same permutation for all 16 molecular columns; conditional approximate permutation reference, +1 correction, max-absolute-correlation correction over 15 primary edges and 256 RNA/256 CNA exploratory families
B.wrong_patient_control: 99 within-block derangements for groups >=2; singleton residuals held fixed and explicitly counted; no claim every row is mismatched
B.random_mapping_control: 999 unique degree-preserving bipartite maps, fixed original row and column degrees and covered concepts, 200 accepted edge swaps each; two-sided association magnitude, no direction assumptions
B.decision: patient-pairing global benchmark p<=0.025 and at least one RNA prior edge maxT<=0.05 with >=4/5 fold signs matching; mapping-specificity benchmark p<=0.025; require both for support for this exact prior
B.independent_morphology: C10 mucinous concept against supplementary HISTOLOGICAL_DIAGNOSIS; known colon/rectal diagnoses only, mucinous substring positive, unknown excluded; report seven ICD 8480/3 disagreements without changing diagnosis labels, additional raw C10 AUC on concordant subset; raw zero-shot AUC and 2000 cancer/diagnosis-stratified conditional bootstrap seed 88311; secondary frozen logistic C=1 nuisance vs nuisance+C10, five patient folds, no DSS
B.cna_cancellation: descriptive only: physical signed raw dosage state mean versus mean absolute dosage for existing measured genes, report distributions and >=50% cancellation among mean-absolute dosage >0.1; not a new representation or proof of negative-result cause
B.limitations: residual conditional permutation relies on within-block exchangeability; overlapping training folds and nuisance estimation uncertainty prevent exact external confirmation; TITAN scores are proxies, mucinous diagnosis does not validate the 15 mapped concepts

publication: aggregate code/reports only; identifiers, individual OOF, residuals, raw data and weights server-private
